about: Photo check of every mat that sat in Orange or Yellow only through a MEASURED colour (accent, or a Claude measured also-colour / crosstag), not a primary and not a Tiffany call. The measurement reads brown/tan/rattan/caramel/cognac as orange (sometimes red) and gold/mustard as orange. build_v5.py applies these to config/mat-accent-colors.json in memory before anything uses it: move = {from: to} moves that measured share to another family (brown -> earthy, gold/mustard -> yellow); drop = the share is removed (not that colour, nothing clear to move it to); accents + major are then recomputed with the file's thresholds. primary + drop_secs = section fix, applied only when Tiffany has not called the mat. Never overrides a Tiffany call (her section calls are applied after this and win).
